title: Etale trivializations for one fixed finite constant model
statement: Let X be a scheme, Λ a finite commutative ring, M a fixed finite Λ-module, and F a pro-etale sheaf of Λ-modules. Suppose a scheme pro-etale covering W_i → X [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] trivializes the inverse image of F with the same constant model M on every member [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then there is an etale covering of X indexed in the universe of X, on each member of which F has constant module model M. The hypothesis imposes a single fixed model; it contains no geometric-stalk or comparison-origin assertion.

source.place: Tag 099Y, proof of lemma-compare-locally-constant; Etale trivializations for one fixed finite constant model

proof.text: Form I(U) = Isom(F.over U, (constant M).over U), with restrictions given by overMapPullback. Glue the hom and inverse in the sheafHom sheaves. Separatedness makes the glued composites identities, so I is a sheaf. Iterated-slice equivalences identify I.over U with the corresponding isomorphism sheaf on the slice, naturally in restriction. These constructions and identities are proved directly in the private localIsom helpers.

For finite modules M,N prove that constant linear maps map locally bijectively to the internal Hom of constant module sheaves. For injectivity intersect the finitely many equalizer sieves obtained by evaluation on every element of M. For surjectivity intersect the image sieves of those finitely many elements. Ignore objects covered by the empty sieve; on every other object the constant sheafification unit of N is injective. Its linear inverse on its image recovers the required linear map. Equality on constant sections implies equality everywhere by local surjectivity of sheafification and separatedness. Lift an isomorphism and its inverse this way; refine by the two equalizer sieves enforcing inverse identities. Sheafifying gives the constant set sheaf Isom(M,N). The fixedConstantHom and fixedConstantIsom helpers prove every part, without a finite-presentation hypothesis or ringed-module transport.

View each given weakly etale scheme-cover map as a small pro-etale object U. The slice equivalence and the canonical comparison between upperStar and localizationRestriction transport the given model to F.over U isomorphic to constant M on the slice. Restriction of the global constant module sheaf is constant. Conjugate the local isomorphism sheaf by these two identifications and use the preceding constant-isomorphism calculation with M=N. Transport across the slice equivalence to see that proEtaleSetRestriction I is the constant set sheaf Aut(M).

The scheme cover gives a CoversTop family on the small pro-etale site, and the fixed models provide sections of I on its members. Thus I is locally constant, hence locally classical. Apply proEtale_locallyClassical_etaleCover to obtain an etale CoversTop family with sections of I. Each section is an isomorphism on the corresponding slice; compose with constant restriction and transport back through the slice equivalence and localizationRestriction to get precisely the required upperStar constant model.

Convert the etale CoversTop family into a jointly surjective family of etale scheme morphisms by evaluating the covering sieve at the terminal etale object. Form its scheme cover and apply Cover.ulift, which chooses a member above every point of X. The resulting universe-u cover inherits the same fixed model. For empty X this family is empty; zero modules and the zero ring are included by the same constructions.

theorem etale_cover_of_proetale_uniform_model
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M]
    (hF : ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (W : I → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (g i)).obj F ≅
            (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝒰.f i)).obj F ≅
          (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (𝒰.X i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
